BEGIN
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then -- Jairam added per IM 5326 on 26-apr-2011

 else
 v_local_time := sysdate;
 end if; 
 
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date is not null then
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date > v_local_time then
 show_error('18014');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date > :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date then
 show_error('7029');
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;
 End if;

 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date is null then
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end if;


END;

 ' drive_id= nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_drive_id,drive_id)' ||
 ' and coll_date between nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date,:ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate-25) and nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date,:ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate)'||
 ' and deferral_id is not null and donor_id is not null and n_audit_flag is null and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ');

 elsif :ctrl_blk_1.s_status='N' then

 select nvl(count(*),0) into :ctrl_blk_1.c_query_count from donations
 where drive_id= nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_drive_id,drive_id)
 and coll_date between nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date,chp_sysdate-25) and nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date,chp_sysdate)
 and deferral_id is not null and donor_id is null and n_audit_flag is null and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 

 set_block_property('donations',default_where ,
 ' drive_id= nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_drive_id,drive_id)' ||
 ' and coll_date between nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date,:ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate-25) and nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date,:ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate)'||
 ' and deferral_id is not null and donor_id is null and n_audit_flag is null and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ');
 else

 select nvl(count(*),0) into :ctrl_blk_1.c_query_count from donations
 where drive_id= nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_drive_id,drive_id)
 and coll_date between nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date,chp_sysdate-25) and nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date,chp_sysdate)
 and deferral_id is not null and n_audit_flag is null and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 
 
 set_block_property('donations',default_where ,
 ' drive_id= nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_drive_id,drive_id)' ||
 ' and coll_date between nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date,:ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate-25) and nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date,:ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate)'||
 ' and deferral_id is not null and n_audit_flag is null and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ');
 end if;


-------------------

 set_application_property(cursor_style,'busy');
 execute_query;
 set_application_property(cursor_style,'default');


 first_record;
 if :donations.drive_id is null then
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date');
 else
 enable_disable('D');
 change_status;
 end if;

END;

PROCEDURE enable_disable(pl_mode in varchar2) IS
BEGIN
 item_change('ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date',pl_mode);
 item_change('ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date',pl_mode); 
 item_change('ctrl_blk_1.s_drive_id',pl_mode);

 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_drive',enabled,property_false);
 else
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_drive',enabled,property_true);
 end if;
 
END;

select a.drive_id,to_char(a.drive_date,'mm-dd-yyyy') drive_dte,c.name from drives a,drive_sponsors b,sponsors c where b.drive_id=a.drive_id and trunc(a.drive_date) between nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date,:ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate-30) and nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date,:ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate) and c.sponsor_id=b.sponsor_id and a.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and c.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and b.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id order by to_date(to_char(a.drive_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'),'mm-dd-yyyy') desc,a.drive_id

 where user_id = LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid
 and read_date is null;
 
 if msg > 0 then
 set_item_property('toolbar.pb_alerts',label,'Msg: '||to_char(msg));
 end if;
exception
 when program_error then
 null; 
end;
